senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced.) circle, association of coevals.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 27b:13">B. Mets. 27ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Yevamot 120a:15">Yeb. 120ᵃ</cite> the same mark <he>מצויה בבן גִּילוֹ</he> is frequently found with those born at the same hour (under the same planetary influences, cmp. <cite ref="C00871"><he>גַּלְגַּל</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Megillah 11a:15">Meg. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>בן גילו וכ׳</he> of the same character.
<cite ref="Nedarim 39b:16">Ned. 39ᵇ</cite> <he>בן גילו</he> (Ar. <cite ref="B00942"><he>בני</he></cite>) of the same age; B.
<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 2:7">Ruth R. to I, 3</cite> <he>מת אחד מן הג׳ ידאג כל הג׳</he> if one of the circle (of the coevals) died, the whole circle must take it to heart.—Pl. <he>גִּילִין</he>.
<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 2:7">Ib.</cite>—v. <cite ref="C00720"><he>גִּילָאֵי</he></cite>. [Y. Orl. II, 61ᵈ bot. <he>גיל השבט</he>, v. <cite ref="C00560"><he>גָּזֵל</he></cite>.]
